column3: “Taken a stand his right hand” is rendered “set His right hand.”
“Garden booth his” is rendered “His tabernacle like a garden booth”; NASB supplies “tabernacle.”
“Testify for you” follows the reading tradition; NASB has “admonish.”
“Worthlessness and sham” is rendered “False and foolish visions”; “turn back your captivity” becomes “restore you from captivity.”
“Their heart cried out” follows the Hebrew; the text is difficult. “Rest” is rendered “relief.”
“Head of the night watches” is rendered “beginning of the night watches.”
“Children of health” is rendered “born healthy”; the meaning is uncertain.
